verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's pricing page lists 'Exportable audit logs' as a feature of its top paid tier. The feature-flag docs describe a revision history: changes are published as revisions with an optional commit message, and you can select a revision to revert to. That gives a first-party record of flag changes, but the evidence never describes the audit log's contents or confirms it captures every change with actor, timestamp and value. missing for 10: documentation that the audit log records who/what/when/old-and-new values for every flag change, detail on audit log scope and export format, availability below the Enterprise tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value

citations.quote: publish them all at once with an optional commit message
use the **Revision** dropdown to select the version you want to revert to, then click **Revert**
